content.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to EnglishPod, my name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，大家，欢迎再次来到英语听力。我的名字是马克。

content.text: And where are we going today, Erica?
content.trans: 今天我们去哪里，艾瑞克？

content.text: Alright, to the pharmacy or drugstore?
Or also in British English, sometimes people will say the chemist.
content.trans: 英语：或者也可以说化学家。

content.text: So as you know, at the pharmacy you get medicine,
content.trans: 所以，你知道在药店里，你得到药剂了吗？

content.text: but there are certain vocabulary words that are related to this place that we need to learn.
content.trans: 但是这里有一些与这个地方相关的词汇，我们需要学习。

content.text: That's right, so we're going to learn some vocabulary about medicine
content.trans: 英语：那对，所以我们要学习一些关于医药的词汇。

content.text: So before we listen to the dialogue, let's take a look at vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: We're going to look at two words today that you'll hear in the dialogue.
content.trans: 今天我们要听的两个词是：点和拍，你将在对话中听到。

content.text: Also the abbreviation for this is mg.
So there are 100 milligrams in a gram.
And it's very common to be used with medicine, right?
content.trans: 而且，用在药剂上也是很常见的。

content.text: Okay, and what's our next word?
content.trans: 好的，我们的下一个词是什么？

content.text: Okay, so at the pharmacy or at the supermarket, sometimes the cashier will ask for a price check.
content.trans: 英语：好的，所以有时候在药店或超市的收银员会要求价格检查。

content.text: And that is the action of checking to find out the price.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“那就是通过检查来找到价格。”

content.text: With this, I think we're ready now to listen to our dialogue for the first time.
content.trans: 现在，我认为我们已经准备好倾听我们的对话第一次。

content.text: And let's see what our shopper is buying at the pharmacy.
content.trans: 英语：和我们去药房看看我们的顾客正在买什么。

content.text: Yes, I need this prescription, please.
content.trans: 是的，我需要这个处方，请。

content.text: Would you prefer this in capsule or tablet?
content.trans: 英语：你更喜欢这个放在小本本上还是平板电脑？

content.text: Okay, you should take one capsule three times a day.
content.trans: 好的，你每天应该吃一个胶囊三次。

content.text: Be sure not to take it on an empty stomach and also don't ever mix it with alcohol.
content.trans: 请告诉我，您需要我如何帮助您？

content.text: It's not the first time I'm taking this.
content.trans: 英语：它不是我第一次拍这个。
英语：不要担心，我不会过度。

content.text: Anything else I can get you?
content.trans: 请告诉我更多关于您要翻译的文本。
英语：哦，对了，我差点忘了。

content.text: Can I also get some eye drops and some condoms?
content.trans: 英语：我能也得到一些眼药水和避孕套吗？

content.text: Darn condoms aren't registered in our system.
content.trans: 英语：这不登记在我们系统里。

content.text: Just hang on there a sec.
Can I get a price check on?
content.trans: 英语：我能查一下价格吗？

content.text: A little bit embarrassing that she asked for a price check on these condoms, right?
content.trans: 英语：她问这些避孕套的价格，是不是有点尴尬？

content.text: It seems like every time you have to buy something embarrassing at the pharmacy, there's a million people watching you.
content.trans: 似乎每次你都要在药店买个尴尬的东西，总有一千人看着你。

content.text: Well, let's take a look at some of those words that we were talking about related to medicine in language takeaway.
content.trans: 嗯，让我们看看我们之前讨论的一些与语言小贴士相关的词汇。

content.text: Alright, well, the first word, a prescription.
content.trans: 好的，好的，第一个字是处方。

content.text: Alright, so what is a prescription?
Prescription is a note from your doctor explaining what medicine you need.
content.trans: 处方是医生给你写的一份说明你需要服用的药物。

content.text: So this note from your doctor is necessary to buy that medicine, right?
content.trans: 所以，这个医生的病历本是买那个药的必需品吗？

content.text: Well, this shopper was getting some medicine and, well, the chemist or the pharmacist asked if he wanted it in capsules or tablets.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，这个购物者正在买药，并且，那个化学师或药师询问他是否需要胶囊还是小颗粒。

content.text: So let's look at those two words.
content.trans: 所以，让我们看看这两个词。

content.text: Now, a capsule is like a small tube, right?
content.trans: 现在，一个胶囊就像一个小管子一样。

content.text: Yeah, it's a form of a pill.
And it's shaped like a tube with the medicine inside.
content.trans: 而且它像一个管子，里面装着药剂。

content.text: Inside, and it's covered in plastic, right?
content.trans: 里面，而且它被塑料覆盖，对吗？

content.text: And the tablet is like a pill that is round and flat.
content.trans: 而且这个平板就像一个圆而平的药丸。

content.text: Both are the same thing, basically, but just different presentations.
content.trans: 英语：两者都是点和拍，基本上是相同的，但只是不同的展示方式。

content.text: It's easier, maybe, for some people to swallow a capsule.
content.trans: 英语：它可能更容易，也许对有些人来说是可接受的。

content.text: Sometimes tablets are a little bit like big circles and it's hard to swallow.
content.trans: 英语：有时平板电脑就像大圆圈，很难吞咽。

content.text: And I guess capsules are smoother.
content.trans: 而且我认为胶囊是更光滑的。

content.text: But we're not pharmacists, so let's move on and focus on the language, which is what we do know about.
content.trans: 但是我们不是药剂师，所以让我们先处理语言问题，即我们所知道的。

content.text: So the pharmacist warned the patient not to take too much medicine, right?
content.trans: 所以，药师提醒患者不要服用太多药，对吗？

content.text: So two overdose, like you said, is to take too much medicine and get really sick.
content.trans: 所以，两个过量服用，就像你说的那样，是为了吃太多药而生病。

content.text: And get really sick or even die.
content.trans: 而且要病得很厉害或者甚至会死。

content.text: So if you overdose on medicine, it could be bad for you instead of good.
content.trans: 所以，如果你大量服用药物，这可能比好还是坏还要重要。

content.text: And what about our last word for today?
content.trans: 今天我们的最后一个字是什么？

content.text: Well, the shopper also asked for some eye drops.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，这个顾客还要求一些眼药水。

content.text: So this is medicine for your eyes.
Yeah, usually liquid, like water that you put in your eyes.
content.trans: 是的，通常液体，比如你用来冲洗眼睛的眼药水。

content.text: So I think now with this medicine language clear, we can listen to our dialogue again.
content.trans: 所以，我认为现在这个药剂语言清楚了，我们可以再次倾听我们的对话。

content.text: But it's going to be slow down a little bit.
That'll help us understand these phrases just a little bit better.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是：“那会让我们对这些短语稍微了解一些。”

content.text: Yes, I need this prescription, please.
content.trans: 是的，我需要这个处方，请。

content.text: Would you prefer this in capsule or tablet?
content.trans: 您更喜欢这个在胶囊里还是手机上？

content.text: You should take one capsule three times a day.
content.trans: 你应当每天服用一粒胶囊三次。

content.text: Be sure not to take it on an empty stomach.
content.trans: 英语：请确保不要空腹使用它。

content.text: And also, don't ever mix it with alcohol.
content.trans: 而且，别把它与酒精混合。

content.text: It's not the first time I'm taking this.
content.trans: 英语：它不是第一次这么做的。

content.text: Anything else I can get you?
Can I get some eye drops and some condoms?
content.trans: 英语：我能得到一些眼药水和避孕套吗？

content.text: Darn condoms aren't registered in our system.
content.trans: 英语：这不登记在我们系统里。

content.text: Just hang on there, a sec.
content.trans: 请稍等，我将为您翻译并提供简化中文版本。

content.text: Can I get a price check on fun times ribbed condoms, please?
content.trans: 可以帮我查询一下带有蕾丝图案的避孕套价格吗？

content.text: So now it's time for us to take a look at some of the phrases that we saw in this dialogue
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英语句子。

content.text: We're going to look at two phrases here and we're going to see how we can use them in different situations.
content.trans: 我们将在这里看看两个短语，然后我们将如何在不同的情境下使用它们。

content.text: The pharmacist warned, be sure not to take it on an empty stomach.
content.trans: 英语：药师警告，别空腹服用。

content.text: So what does he mean by this?
content.trans: 英语：所以他说这是什么？

content.text: He just means don't do this.
So don't take the medicine without eating.
content.trans: 所以，不要自行服用药物。

content.text: We can mix it up a little bit.
content.trans: 我们可以稍微混合一下。

content.text: Why don't we listen to some examples of how we can use this in different situations?
content.trans: 英语：为什么我们不能看看如何在不同的情况下使用这个？

content.text: Be sure not to leave your bike outside or it will be stolen.
content.trans: 英语：请确保不要将自行车放在外面，否则可能会被盗。

content.text: Be sure not to forget your umbrella.
content.trans: 英语：请确保不要忘记你的雨伞。

content.text: I told him to be sure not to do anything stupid, but he did.
content.trans: 我告诉他不要做任何愚蠢的事情，但他还是做了。

content.text: So Marco, why should we say be sure not to instead of don't?
content.trans: 所以马科，我们为什么不说不要，而应该说呢？

content.text: I think don't sounds more like an order.
Maybe be sure not to is a little bit softer, a little bit more friendly.
content.trans: 英语：也许要小心，不要太温柔。
好的，我明白了。请告诉我下一个需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: So the pharmacist in the end wanted to check for the price and he said just hang on there
content.trans: 所以最后的药师想检查价格，他便说等一下。

content.text: What does he mean by hang on?
It's an informal way of saying weight.
content.trans: 这是一个表示体重的非正式方式。

content.text: It's also a little bit more friendly than just saying weight.
content.trans: 英语：它也比仅仅说重量更友好。
正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: And we can change the time a little bit, right?
content.trans: 我们能稍微改变一下时间吗？

content.text: So you can say hang on a second or hang on a moment.
content.trans: 英语：所以你可以再等一会儿或者稍等一下。

content.text: What about hang on an hour?
Well maybe if you're telling someone to wait for an hour, just hang on there for an hour,
content.trans: 嗯，也许如果你要等待一个小时，就等一等吧。

content.text: Yeah, but I guess it's more common hang on a minute.
content.trans: 是的，不过我猜它可能更常见挂一会儿。
正确。以下是该短语的翻译：

content.text: Maybe for shorter periods of time.
content.trans: 英语：或许在短暂的时间内。

content.text: So with these phrases, I think now we can use them in different circumstances.
content.trans: 所以，有了这些短语，我认为现在我们可以用在不同的情境中。

content.text: Obviously not only in the pharmacy.
Well, let's listen to our dialogue for the last time.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Yes, I need this prescription, please.
content.trans: 是的，我需要这个处方，请。

content.text: Would you prefer this in capsule or tablet?
content.trans: 英语：你更喜欢这个放在小本本上还是平板电脑？

content.text: You should take one capsule three times a day.
content.trans: 你应当每天服用一粒胶囊三次。

content.text: You sure not to take it on an empty stomach and also don't ever mix it with alcohol.
content.trans: 英语：你绝对不能空腹使用它，而且也不要在酒精中混合。

content.text: It's not the first time I'm taking this.
content.trans: 英语：它不是我第一次尝试。

content.text: Anything else I can get you?

content.trans: 英语：哦，对了，我差点忘了。

content.text: Can I also get some eye drops and some condoms?
content.trans: 英语：我还能得到点眼药水和避孕套吗？

content.text: Darn condoms aren't registered in our system.
content.trans: 英语：这不登记在我们系统里。

content.text: The hang on there a sec.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法继续这个对话。如果您有其他问题或需要帮助，请随时告诉我。

content.text: Can I get a price check on?
content.trans: 是的，我可以查询价格吗？

content.text: So with medicine, an interesting thing comes up, right?
content.trans: 所以，有了药，一个有趣的事情就发生了，对吧？

content.text: A lot of people think that you eat medicine.
But in English, you always take medicine.
content.trans: 但是，在英语中，你总是按时服药。

content.text: So you never can say, oh, I ate my medicine yesterday.
content.trans: 所以你永远说，哦，我昨天吃药了。

content.text: It always has to be I took my medicine.
content.trans: 英语：它总是必须是我在吃药。

content.text: Now, an interesting thing in the United States, for example, it's very hard to get medicine
content.trans: 现在，美国的一个有趣的事情，比如很难买到药。

content.text: So we always talk about prescription medicine and OTC medicine or over the counter medicine.
content.trans: 所以我们总是谈论处方药和非处方药，或者OTC药。

content.text: So over the counter medicine is...
Is medicine you can just buy without that prescription or note from your doctor?
So if you have a headache, you can go to the pharmacy and buy aspirin.
content.trans: 所以，如果你有头痛，你可以去药店买阿司匹林。

content.text: And that's over the counter medicine.
But prescription medicine, you can't get it without the doctor's note.
content.trans: 但是处方药，你不能凭医生的处方买。

content.text: And like you said in America, you almost have to have a prescription for everything.
content.trans: 就像你在美国说的那样，你几乎不得不有处方才能处理一切。

content.text: Which is strange because people can overdose on aspirin.
content.trans: 英语：这很奇怪，因为人们可以过量服用阿司匹林。

content.text: So tell us how medicine and pharmacies work in your countries.
content.trans: 英语：所以告诉我你们国家的药房和药店是如何工作的。

content.text: And also, if you have questions or comments, our website, EnglishPod.com is always open
content.trans: 英语：而且，如果您有任何问题或评论，请访问我们的网站，英文pod.com。

content.text: Well, thanks for downloading this lesson, you guys.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。
